audit.whatIsWrong: The content 'late' field claims your DoT 'shreds through her E parry-block windows since Twin Fang doesn't care about spell-shields'. Irelia's E is Flawless Duet, a stun — the block is W, Defiant Dance, and it reduces PHYSICAL damage only, so it never touched your magic damage in the first place. wants.foe[2] likewise says she uses E 'to nullify your R stun', which no part of her kit does.
audit.why: Enemy W text: 'She takes reduced physical damage during the charge.' Enemy E text: 'Enemies caught in between are damaged, stunned and Marked.' There is no spell shield anywhere in her kit.
audit.corrected: Defiant Dance blunts physical damage while charging; your poison and fangs pass through it untouched. Flawless Duet is a two-blade stun you dodge by standing off the convergence line.

audit.why: EVEN 5.5/10 at 47.84% over 811 games: levels 2-3 are hers on Bladesurge resets, and everything from Miasma onward is yours.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five phases[N].side rows disagreed with content win[N] and the packet: rows 1 and 2 read 'Skill' where both say Irelia, and rows 3, 4 and 6 read 'Skill' where both say Cassiopeia.
audit.why: Bladesurge costs 15 mana and refreshes on any Marked or dying target, which is why levels 2-3 are hers; Miasma's grounding is what takes the lane back at 4-5.
audit.corrected: Five sides realigned, with phases[1].why and phases[2].why rewritten in the same proposal so the sentences match their new verdicts.

edits.before: Liandry's Torment (or Riftmaker) into Rabadon's is the standard build — the DoT ramp shreds through her E parry-block windows since Twin Fang doesn't care about spell-shields the way burst does. Zhonya's is close to mandatory since her all-in is a hard engage you can't kite away from with no boots. By two items your poison ticks kill her through most of her healing, and R becomes a genuine execute if you can land it while she's out of dashes.
edits.after: Liandry's Torment (or Riftmaker) into Rabadon's is the standard build — Defiant Dance only reduces physical damage while she charges it, so your poison and fangs pass through the block untouched. Zhonya's is close to mandatory since her all-in is a hard engage you can't kite away from with no boots. By two items your poison ticks kill her through her Bladesurge healing if you bought Grievous Wounds, and R becomes a genuine execute while she is out of dashes.
